snippet.title: 【Gravity Shooter】  Gravity × Bullet Heaven Shooter | Trailer
snippet.description:
Control the ball with gravity and defeat waves of incoming enemies!

Gravity Shooter is an SF shooting game that incorporates survivor-style elements.

Use the gravity device “Gravity Shield” to control the ball,
defeat enemies freely across the field, and collect items.

Upgrade your weapons and skills to survive the relentless enemy assault!

🎮 Demo available on Steam! 🎮
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4035250/Gravity_Shooter/

※Footage is from a development build.
